name: usmon-shashlik
description: USMON SHASHLIK — Telegram Mini App + Admin Panel + Node.js Backend

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:admin
scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.render:build: npm run install:all && npm run db:generate && npm run build
scripts.render:start: cd backend && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss && node prisma/seed.js && npm start
